notes.title: Update v1.8 - Refinement
notes.content:
Get ready to embark on an even more immersive journey across the Martian landscape with the latest update of MarsVR! We've been working hard to make your virtual Mars experience better than ever.

🚗 Rover Driving – Beta Experience (Thrilling but Caution Advised!) 🚗
You spoke, and we listened! By popular demand for the community, we're thrilled to introduce the much-anticipated beta experience of Rover Driving. This isn't just any driving experience – it's crafted with your adventurous spirit in mind. Experience the thrill of driving a Rover on the Martian surface. It's still in beta, so adventures come with a hint of unpredictability. Drive with caution – Martian driving rules are a bit different from Earth's!

🛠 Enhanced Project Optimization & Faster Scene Loading 🛠
We've revved up our engines to bring you faster and smoother scene loading. Now, you'll transition between your Mars adventures with incredible speed and efficiency. Get ready to explore with less waiting and more doing!

🎬 New, Engaging Opening Intro Animation 🎬
Kickstart your Mars mission with our brand-new opening animation. It sets the stage for your thrilling exploration of the red planet, capturing the essence of adventure right from the start.

🌟 Visual Quality Upgrades 🌟
The red planet just got more realistic. We've enhanced shadows and textures, giving Mars a more lifelike appearance. You might find yourself reaching out to touch the Martian soil!

🎤 New Voiceovers and Clearer Experience Explanations 🎤
To enhance your journey, we've added new voiceovers. These will guide you through the Mars landscape, providing both essential information and interesting facts to enrich your exploration.

Update now and dive back into the wonders of the MDRS with these new and improved features. Your Martian journey awaits with more discoveries and excitement than ever before.

Explore On!

The MarsVR Team

notes.title: Update V 1.5 - The big update!
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback.  From reading your comments, it's great to learn what you want to explore, interact with, learn, and find.  While many of these elements were always planned, we listened to your comments, learned what you want, and integrated as many of your suggestions as we can... and those we didn't are planned for future builds.

[b]What is new?
[/b] Since our last build, we've been chipping away at your requests... adding our new features (like mars vs earth experiments, educational pop-ups, tons of easter eggs, full exploration of building interiors.  We've also been adding improvements throughout this educational experience, from options to skip the intro flight and voice-over tour, to adding latest mars news (can you find the coral, the martian doorway, or hovering ingenuity?).  From testing at numerous space-related events and conventions, we are learning what works, what keeps you engaged, and what you'd like to learn. 

This update brings all the fundamental performance improvements we needed to add, additional world interactions, a massive update to the map (better quality, optimization, and 3x the size).

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h3]Interiors [/h3] The interiors of all buildings can now be toured and viewed, with educational interactables and easter eggs galore
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41886471/72167b82dc800ece450ee1567683c965a4c97073.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41886471/4d3f85d464ee14fbcecada95ae5018e39e6efd8c.png[/img]

[h3]Mapping Device [/h3] Used for tracking missions, changing music and other options
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41886471/e024e3aa6f40d1d745bf0e8d080f20562b805884.png[/img]

[h3]Larger Map [/h3] The tourable map is over 300% larger, optimized, with more LODs, and improved quality (plus a few easter eggs)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41886471/129af74dbc3e5c98ff76aac4dc239b241559e4b1.png[/img]

[h3]Main Menu UI[/h3] You now have options to skip the flight and the tour.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41886471/c871d9f1839f1af26bef10f66e0e59f9a0950399.png[/img]

Other various hidden events and info around the map.


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Frame Rate improvements 
[*]LOD groups optimized 
[*]Lighting improved
[*]Boarder added around map bounds
[*]Space Gravity added
[*]Model Optimization 
[*]Player controller interaction fixes
[*]Filled holes in environment 
[*]Start Fly in path improved
[*]Shader optimization mainly on tour
[*]Achievements are now properly detected
[/list]


[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We need you to explore, learn, and keep providing feedback.
This experience is intended to be an interactive educational tour of the MDRS more than a game, however, it's nice to add features and science in a way that gamifies learning.  
We are working on 
We hope you enjoy these updates, keep sharing ideas, and we'll see you on Mars!

[h1]Spoiler Alert[/h1]
Check out your backpack for some extra abilities, easter eggs, and achievements!
Try throwing a gas can, notice anything special about the red v blue?
Can you find the soccer ball - how does it bounce?
How many easter eggs can you find?
Can you beat your friends to conquer all the achievements?
